title: Design of a Power Screw for a Hydraulic Press
subject: PCC303-MEC

courseOutcome.statement: Design power screws, fasteners, and power transmission elements by applying torque, efficiency, and self-locking criteria for safe and reliable mechanical operation.

client: Heavy Press Machinery Division — Hydraulic Press Bed Positioning System

tasks.title: Understand Hydraulic Press and Bed-Adjustment Power Screw Application
Identify Hydraulic Press and Power-Screw Components
Differentiate Hydraulic Pressing Load Path vs Bed-Adjustment Mechanism
Establish Engineering Design Requirements and Given Parameters
Determine Screw Geometry, Core/Mean Diameters, and Helix Angle
Calculate Virtual Friction Angle and Thread Friction Torque
Calculate Mean Collar Diameter and Thrust Collar Friction Torque
Determine Total Operating Torque, Handwheel Effort, and Efficiency
Evaluate Self-Locking Condition, Lowering Torque, and Fail-Safe Operation
Stress Analysis (Direct Compressive, Torsional Shear, Combined) and FOS Verification
Hydraulic Press Power Screw Design & Analysis Report
